The final attempt to verify the content of the revision (step 9) also failed due to a `NameError` and used an incorrect `revision_id` (which was from the 2019 timeframe, not the 2024 date found). As a result, no definitive, verified date was provided in the requested DD/MM/YYYY format, and the task remains incomplete with conflicting information.
